templates.partial/about:
Who I am?

Who I am?

I am an experienced designer and developer

As a passionate designer and developer, I transform ideas into reality with creativity and responsibility.

With years of experience in graphic design, website development, and creating visual identities, I deliver innovative and high-quality solutions that strengthen brands and stand out in the market.

My portfolio ranges from impactful logos to intuitive user interfaces, always aligned with the best SEO practices to ensure the visibility and success of my clients.

I like to work on visual identity projects that help brands position themselves in the market, bringing their characteristics, personality and values.

At the core of each brand lies a carefully crafted world, where each attribute is strategically designed to meet the unique needs of our customers.

From the logo to the colors, typography and graphics, we design a striking and personalized experience that echoes the identity of each business.

Unity

A company without a well-developed visual identity has no personality. With a brand manual and a good visual identity, your audience can identify it wherever they go.

Credibility

A well-crafted visual identity brings confidence to those who see it, adding greater credibility and professionalism to the brand.

Attraction

Attracting the right audience and communicating with it correctly. A clear and professionally developed visual identity ensures the most appropriate communication.
templates.partial/methodology:
Creation process

In my creation process I use the following steps

1

Knowing the Client and the Company

In the first stage, I seek to gather as much information about the characteristics and personality of the client and the company. A detailed questionnaire with strategic questions about the project.

2

Search

With the information collected, I begin to research the company, the market it operates in, its competitors and target audience. Essential so the creation process is well-founded and not generic.

3

Concept

According to the results obtained in the research, I start a brainstorming process, mapping ideas and drafting concepts, always looking for a greater meaning beyond the visual.

4

Execution

After all the tests, and with an established idea, I start defining typography and colors, in addition to creating shapes, graphics, patterns and support elements.

5

Flexibility

With everything in hand, I begin the application stage in products such as stationery, uniforms, billboards and gifts, ensuring the brand is identified in any situation.

6

Delivery

With the project finalized, I create and send a presentation and the manual for using the brand. Once approved, all files are saved, organized and sent to the customer.
